issues.description: 258 words is still on the long side for this account, and the post now has two candidate closing beats: the worth-it/not-worth-it pair and the three-briefs test. Both earn their place, but a reader on mobile hits the truncation fold before the shared-state point.
issues.action: No change required. Accepted deliberately: everything above the fold is the hook plus the two numbers, which is exactly what should be there. Flagged only so a future run does not add to this length.
